NAME: Numbing Strike
DESCR: PHYSICAL SILENCE: the target's physical skills fail for the duration. Its BASIC ATTACK still works. Contested ATK vs CON.

NAME: Silencing Ward
DESCR: MAGICAL SILENCE: the target's magical skills fail for the duration. Land this AND a physical silence and the target is FULLY silenced. Contested ATK vs SPT.
